purpose: Fixture-specific, read-only inspection of native Microsoft Word section extensions, collapsed-heading metadata, caption and AutoCaption field output, legacy symbols, Unicode scalar text, and footnotes across DOCX, DOTX, DOC, DOT, and RTF.

provenance.authoring_method: Computer Use / native Microsoft Word UI
provenance.source: Synthetic markers were entered in a fresh native Word document. Word Format Paragraph authored the collapsed Heading 1 state, the native footnote layout dialog authored two footnote-area columns, Insert Caption authored the Figure field, and Word's AutoCaption rule for tables authored the Table field before the rule was restored to zero without a final resave. More Symbols authored a legacy Symbol-font infinity field; the emoji was entered as a Unicode scalar with Apple Color Emoji formatting. Word saved DOTX and then DOT, the DOTX was reopened and corrected to the final DOCX before the DOC derivative was saved, and the corrected DOCX was reopened before the RTF derivative was saved.

files.role: native OOXML source after the caption correction
native Word RTF derivative from the corrected DOCX

coverage.evidence: DOCX and DOTX each contain one direct w15:collapsed element under the Heading 1 paragraph's w:pPr. Its namespace URI is http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2012/wordml and it has no val attribute, which the library codec interprets as enabled. The native UI reopened the heading in the saved collapsed state. The public DOCX paragraph facade returned None for this source-backed paragraph, so the package XML is the authoritative fixture evidence and the projection gap is recorded below.

DOCX and DOTX each contain one direct w15:footnoteColumns child of the final w:sectPr with w:val=2. The root mc:Ignorable list contains w15, and the body w:cols has no num attribute, so the two-column setting is specifically on the footnote area rather than the main body. word/footnotes.xml contains user footnote id=1 with FOOTNOTE_COLUMN_016. The public section facade returned no layout and its extracted sectPr omitted the unknown extension; raw package evidence is authoritative.

DOCX, DOTX, DOC, DOT, and RTF preserve the native Figure and Table SEQ fields with cached result 1. The table was created by the native AutoCaption rule and contains AUTO_TABLE_016, Amount, Native AutoCaption, and 42. No finalized DOC or DOT carries nonzero-length caption metadata tables: FIB pointer 52 and 53 are present with lcb=0, and typed caption_tables() reports labels=None and auto=None even for the template DOT. Therefore this fixture proves native SEQ/AutoCaption field output but does not claim SttbfCaption or SttbfAutoCaption table coverage.

coverage.feature: Legacy symbol and Unicode scalar controls
coverage.evidence: DOCX and DOTX contain one legacy w:sym with w:font=Symbol and w:char=F0A5, plus a separate w:t containing U+1F600 with Apple Color Emoji run fonts. There are zero Word 2015 symEx elements. RTF preserves the legacy symbol as a SYMBOL 165 field and the emoji as paired RTF Unicode controls. The fixture must not be counted as Run symEx coverage.

observations: DOCX and DOTX reopened with the collapsed Heading 1, one footnote, native Figure and Table caption fields, the table, legacy infinity symbol, and emoji visible.
DOC and DOT reopened as native Word binary files with the same markers, caption fields/table, footnote, and visible symbol content.
RTF reopened without repair and displayed the resolved caption fields, table, legacy symbol, emoji, and body markers.

The Word Table AutoCaption rule was temporarily enabled, confirmed after reopening DOT, then restored to zero and closed without resaving; no claim is made that the final DOT stores the AutoCaption preference tables.
native_ui_validation.semantic_scope: Native UI observations establish save/close/reopen acceptance and visible content. They do not establish field refresh, pagination, layout rendering equivalence, or library support beyond the recorded raw-package and typed-reader probes.

known_limits: The DOCX/DOTX raw XML proves w15:collapsed and w15:footnoteColumns, but the current source-backed DOCX paragraph and section facades did not project those inherited namespace extensions in the read-only probe.

The final DOT has the template FIB bit but zero-length FIB 52/53 ranges. Native SEQ fields and a table created while AutoCaption was enabled are not equivalent to persisted SttbfCaption/SttbfAutoCaption metadata.
The DOC and DOT derivatives have no OOXML namespace extensions, so no binary conversion claim is made for collapsed-heading or footnoteColumns semantics.
The legacy w:sym/SYMBOL field and ordinary Unicode emoji are intentional negative controls for Word 2015 symEx; symEx coverage remains absent.

The RTF reopened in native Word but litchi-rtf rejects it before semantic traversal because of the native empty data-store payload. Raw control counts and textutil output are evidence of file contents, not a successful litchi-rtf parse.
No field refresh, AutoCaption preference resave, document protection, user editing, pagination, or visual-rendering equivalence was tested.
